main.description: Looks up an actor's indexed organization sidecar and associated profile. The organization sidecar must exist; a missing profile is represented as null. Authentication is not required.

actor.description: DID of the actor whose organization sidecar is requested.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The actor DID is invalid or a query parameter is not accepted.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No indexed organization sidecar exists for this DID.

organizationActorView.description: Actor with its required organization sidecar and nullable base profile.
